ORDINANCE XXXVI OF

An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Board of Technical Education Ordinance.
1970
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part- I, 12th October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.1(36)/2002. dated
12-10-2002.-----The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Board of
technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

Amendment of section 10 of Sindh Ordinance No.XVI of 1970

ORDINANCE XXXVI OF 2002
SINDH BOARD OF
TECHNICAL EDUCATON
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVI OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Board of Technical Education Ordinance.
1970
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part- I, 12th October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.1(36)/2002. dated
12-10-2002.-----The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Amendment of section 10 of
Sindh Ordinance No.XVI of 1970.--In the Sindh Board of Technical Education
Ordinance, 1970, for section 10, the following shall be substituted:--
"10. The Governor of Sindh
shall be the Controlling Authority of the Board.".
